entities.summary: Thembi Seete (b. 1977-03-25, Soweto) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Soweto and South Africa. Known in the fields of south africa, composers & musicians, africa.
